title: The structural dynamics and molecular coupling in the slow inactivation of a prokaryotic voltage-gated sodium channel
task: Elucidate structural mechanism and molecular coupling of slow inactivation in voltage-gated sodium channels
key_results: NavAb selectivity filter transits among three conformational states with depolarization enriching high FRET state; L176-T206 steric-hindrance coupler identified as key residue pair coupling primary and inactivation gates
comments: Single-molecule FRET provides dynamic conformational insights, though functional validation of the proposed 'conformational talk' mechanism would strengthen conclusions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selectivity filter serves as slow inactivation gate
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SF transitions among three states with depolarization enriching high FRET conformation

hypotheses.hypothesis: L176-T206 residue pair couples primary and inactivation gates

model_io.model: human HCC cell lines and patient samples

title: Unsupervised machine learning for automated crystal orientation mapping on noisy 4D-STEM data
task: Automated crystal orientation mapping from noisy 4D-STEM data via unsupervised learning
key_results: Self-supervised denoising eliminates need for clean training images; rotation-invariant analysis identifies minor crystallographic components missed by expert analysis
comments: The use of spatial context from neighboring probe positions for denoising is clever and particularly valuable for beam-sensitive materials.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-supervised denoising leveraging spatial context outperforms methods requiring clean training images
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on synthetic data across noise levels; robust performance validated

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotation-invariant unsupervised analysis identifies crystallographic components that expert manual analysis may miss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; minor components detected in experimental data

title: Non-magnetic ground state in A2WCl6, A = Cs, Rb, K: Face-centered cubic system with spin-orbit-entangled J = 2 states
task: Characterize ground state and multipolar properties of face-centered cubic tungsten chlorides with spin-orbit coupling
key_results: K2WCl6 undergoes cubic-to-tetragonal transition yielding non-magnetic singlet ground state; Rb2WCl6 and Cs2WCl6 remain non-magnetic without phase transition; local quadrupolar distortions likely present
comments: Chemical disorder prevents long-range multipolar ordering despite strong spin-orbit coupling, highlighting the role of disorder in suppressing exotic ordered phases.

model_io.model: Spin-orbit coupling and crystal field theory

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural distortion in K2WCl6 reconstructs J=2 manifold to stabilize non-magnetic singlet
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cubic-to-tetragonal transition observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chemical disorder suppresses long-range multipolar ordering in Rb and Cs compounds
hypotheses.result: Supported; local structural anomalies observed without long-range ordering

title: Field profiling and magnetic axis reconstruction in solenoids using a translating induction-coil magnetometer
task: Reconstruct magnetic axis and axial field profile in solenoids using translating induction-coil magnetometer
key_results: Cylindrical-harmonic expansion method achieves ~100 μm magnetic-axis repeatability; superior accuracy and linearity versus polynomial baseline
comments: Imposition of Maxwellian consistency through harmonic expansion is elegant and practically valuable for precision magnet alignment in accelerator applications.

outputs: magnetic flux density profile along axis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harmonic expansion enforcing Maxwellian consistency improves reconstruction accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; harmonic method superior to polynomial approximation in accuracy and linearity

title: Disentangling universality from shape in Platonic granular packings
task: Link particle shape to packing statistics in disordered granular assemblies
key_results: Face-face contacts binomially distributed; cluster growth follows random-walk statistics independent of shape; local density controlled by contact number and packing fraction
comments: MRI reconstruction provides direct 3D evidence that geometric frustration from particle shape propagates universally across length scales.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Face-face contact probability encodes shape-specific frustration and controls cluster size universally
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; binomial distribution of contacts with shape-dependent probability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cluster growth exhibits random-walk statistics independent of particle shape
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across all five Platonic solids
